blocks.x: How Achala Nexus is put together: the planes, the controls and the evidence export, written the way your auditors read.

The Achala Nexus architecture is three planes and an evidence spine. Modules compose behind one governed API; every decision crossing a plane boundary is logged with the inputs, the policy version and the accountable owner.
In Achala Nexus architecture, the build decomposes into named pieces, each with an owner and a gate:

items: one single entry point with SLA guarantees
versioned decision policies with effective-dating and simulation
shadow scoring and incremental traffic shifting
online feature store with point-in-time correctness

blocks.x: The platform tracks these by default, Achala Nexus edition:

Runtime dependencies: Databricks Feature Store, Kafka/Flink, Redis, OPA, core-system adapters. Deployment runs inside your security perimeter with customer-managed keys; the evidence export is formatted for the audit formats your team already uses.

Deployment models for Achala Nexus follow the estate: in-perimeter on customer-managed keys, or in a segregated enclave where the estate cannot host the workload. Either way the control pack, the replay log and the audit export keep the same format, so the second deployment never re-argues the first.
Bring one decision flow to a 45-minute briefing. We will show it running on Achala Nexus and leave you with a written feasibility note you can circulate.
